statBlock.name: Modron Monodrone
statBlock.description: The lowest rank of Mechanus follows orders from duodrones. It can fly and attack with force-charged gears.

sections.Traits: Disintegration. The modron turns to dust when it dies. Its gear and anything else it wore or carried remain.
sections.Actions:
Gear. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) Force damage.
Gear Flinger. Ranged attack, +4 to hit, range 120 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) Force damage.

statBlock.name: Modron Duodrone
statBlock.description: Duodrones direct monodrones as part of the Mechanus hierarchy. They can throw their clockwork blades and catch them as they fly back.

sections.Traits: Disintegration. The modron turns to dust when it dies. Its gear and anything else it wore or carried remain.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Clockwork Blade attacks.
Clockwork Blade. Melee or ranged attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft. A hit deals 4 (1d6 + 1) Force damage. The blade immediately returns by magic to the duodrone's hand after a ranged attack, whether it hit or missed.

statBlock.name: Modron Tridrone
statBlock.description: Tridrones carry out quadrone orders and pass instructions to duodrones. A thrown clockwork spear returns to its wielder.

sections.Traits: Disintegration. The modron turns to dust when it dies. Its gear and anything else it wore or carried remain.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Clockwork Spear attacks.
Clockwork Spear. Melee or ranged attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. A hit deals 4 (1d6 + 1) Force damage. The spear immediately returns by magic to the tridrone's hand after a ranged attack, whether it hit or missed.

statBlock.name: Modron Quadrone
statBlock.description: A flying officer from Mechanus. It oversees tridrones and can fire gears over long distances.

sections.Traits: Disintegration. The modron turns to dust when it dies. Its gear and anything else it wore or carried remain.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Choose either four Slam attacks or four Gears Launcher attacks.
Slam. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) Force damage.
Gears Launcher. Ranged attack, +4 to hit, range 320 ft. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) Force damage.

statBlock.name: Modron Pentadrone
statBlock.description: A large enforcer in the Mechanus hierarchy. It directs quadrones and can pin down intruders with a blast of paralysis gas.

sections.Traits: Disintegration. The modron turns to dust when it dies. Its gear and anything else it wore or carried remain.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Choose either five Slam attacks or five Electrical Discharge attacks.
Slam. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) Force damage.
Electrical Discharge. Ranged attack, +4 to hit, range 120 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) Lightning damage.
Paralysis Gas (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 30-ft. Cone makes a DC 11 Constitution save. A creature that fails is Paralyzed. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. After 1 minute it succeeds automatically.
